title: Reading vector
description: A test vector of reading (section 7 of the legal text): parts, each perhaps with the part of the release before, and what section 5 gives. A reader implements section 5 and gets exactly this.

passport.description: The passport as YAML reads it: any value, not only one the schema accepts.

propertyNames.description: A file's path from the part, such as texts/privacy-policy/1.md, or a translation's, such as texts/privacy-policy/1.ru.md.

files.description: The files under texts/, by their paths from the part.

previous.description: The part of the release before, which legal.in-force-unchanged reads. Left out when that release has no legal/.

texts.description: The current version of every text that has one.

sets.description: The current version of every set that has one.

current.description: What the reader gives a part it accepts. Left out when it refuses the part.

refused_by.description: The step that refuses the part: the schema, or the ID of the rule. Left out when the reader accepts it.

items.description: A path of the passport, a text or set as texts.<id> or sets.<id>, or a file by its path from the part.

names.description: Every name that step gives, in the order of code units.

propertyNames.description: The ID of a text or of a set.
